description.zh: 是否强制重启。当云手机遇到系统、网络等异常原因导致无法关机时，可选择强制重启（可能会丢失未保存数据）。
description.en: Specifies whether to forcefully reboot the instances. If a Cloud Phone instance cannot be shut down because of system or network errors, you can force a reboot. This operation may cause data loss.

descriptions.zh: 只有实例处于**可用、异常、备份失败、恢复失败**状态时才支持重启。
descriptions.en: You can reboot an instance only if its status is Active, Abnormal, Backup failed, or **Recover failed**.
